material: art-direction styles (skills/art-direction/styles/*.md), rewritten from an MIT knowledge pack
tree: .claude/skills (the .cursor/ tree is a byte-identical mirror and was not used)
how: rewritten, not copied: numbers kept where the pipeline applies them (upper end of each upstream range); franchise, game, studio and product names removed; modelling operations replaced by outcomes

lowpoly-style/SKILL.md.used_for: triangle targets (prop 50-500, environment module 100-800), flat shading, texture sizes (512 default, 256-512 most, 1024 hero only), shape and material guidance

lowpoly-style/references/ps1-aesthetic.m.used_for: flat shading; optional point filtering and retro limits (listed as not applied or left to retro-horror)

references/polycount-budgets.md.used_for: style modifier: 50-90% reduction against standard budgets (context for the targets)

psx-horror-style/SKILL.md.used_for: flat or very low smoothing, nearest filtering, limited palette, chunky few-part modelling

psx-horror-style/references/psx-horror-b.used_for: prop 50-400 tris and 64-128 px; room chunk 500-2000 tris and 256-512 px atlas

psx-horror-style/references/psx-horror-p.used_for: palette words for the texture brief

lowpoly-style/references/ps1-aesthetic.m.used_for: limited palette, 16-64 colours per scene (upper end applied per map)

visual-console-eras/references/ps1-ps2.m.used_for: no mip filtering in the era (context for NEAREST filtering)

voxel-style/SKILL.md.used_for: grid occupancy, no smooth shading over block edges, nearest-neighbour textures, small palette

voxel-style/references/voxel-grid.md.used_for: palette 16-32 colours (upper end applied per map)

voxel-style/references/voxel-characters..used_for: parts at least one cell thick, readable from four side views

realistic-style/SKILL.md.used_for: real-world scale, 2K-4K hero / 2K typical game textures, geometry vs texture detail split

realistic-style/references/pbr-values.md.used_for: metallic 0 or 1, dielectric albedo never pure black or white (already the project's albedo range rule)

realistic-style/references/scan-cleanup..used_for: read; workflow only (scan clean-up is not a pipeline step), nothing applied

references/polycount-budgets.md.used_for: trim sheets 2048-4096 shared; hero prop 15,000-50,000 tris (not applied: above the engine budget)

stylized-style/SKILL.md.used_for: shape language, exaggeration, small colour plan, detail in texture

stylized-style/references/npr-shaders.md.used_for: toon bands, outlines, rim light (listed as needing a pipeline feature)

anime-style/SKILL.md.used_for: clean silhouettes, simplified forms, flat tonal regions, hard shadow terminators

anime-style/references/cel-shader-setup..used_for: cel shading and outlines (listed as needing a pipeline feature)

isometric-style/SKILL.md.used_for: high three-quarter readability, top and side planes, no hidden detail

isometric-style/references/iso-camera.md.used_for: locked camera (listed as needing a pipeline feature)

hand-painted-style/SKILL.md.used_for: brushwork in albedo, low roughness variation, atlas-friendly

hand-painted-style/references/paint-work.used_for: subtle or no normal maps, value-then-hue painting

painterly-style/SKILL.md.used_for: soft terminators, limited harsh specular (brief wording)
